items.title: 18.3 Dominance relations and multiple alleles (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Matar ke paude (Yy) mein dominant allele (Y) poori tarah zahir hota hai aur recessive allele (y) bilkul zahir nahi hota. Is liye Yy mein koi darmiyani (intermediate) rang nahi aata; beej poora peela hota hai. Ise complete dominance (mukammal dominance) kehte hain. Jab sciencedanon ne Mendel ke khayalat ko jaancha to har baar nataij aik jaise nahi the. Bohat si khasiyatein complete dominance nahi dikhatin, aur kuch khasiyatein do se zyada alleles control karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Complete dominance kya hai? Misaal dein.
blocks.explanation: Heterozygote mein dominant allele poora zahir hota hai aur recessive bilkul nahi, is liye heterozygote dominant homozygote jaisa dikhta hai. Misaal: Yy matar ke beej YY ki tarah peele hote hain.

items: Complete dominance: Yy bilkul YY jaisa (peela).
Is se hat kar: incomplete dominance, co-dominance aur multiple alleles (agle topics).
